title: Sidecar check
author: Iced-Cream
description: A test for the core-ar2 0.11 calls the Sidecar mods use, checked in RAM. Part 1 (core 0.11): a SIDECAR CHECK page behind the LFO key and one behind the FX LFO key, with knob ids 560..563 whose p-locks the mod keeps itself (core_param_locks): per id, track and step, in RAM, with every call logged after the magic SCK1. The knobs show their labels (SCA..SCD) and names (SC KNOB A..D), with a trig held the value text shows the held step (core_held_step), and on each tick it notes track 1's trigs and lock trigs on steps 1..16. Part 2 (core 0.11): a step tag owner (core_step_owners) whose tags it sets, reads and walks on commands written into its record after the magic SCK2, logging every ev_steps event; and a measure of the heap's free space.
